Figure 13: Ablation on the number of clustering queries across three benchmarks.

Figure 8: Consistency and separation of induced hard partitions across K on three benchmarks. Left: in-cluster BT profile consistency (↑); Middle: inter-cluster BT profile similarity (↓); Right: cross-cluster ranking quality gap (↑). Rows correspond to benchmarks: SPROUT (top), RouterBench (middle), and Open LLM Leaderboard v2 (bottom). Methods incorporating comparison signals (ECC, Comp-only) consistently yield higher within-cluster consistency, lower inter-cluster similarity, and larger cross-cluster quality gaps.
